key_insight: PhysMiner combines triple-decomposition physics extraction with agentic LLM reasoning to discover turbulence mechanisms while reducing shear-contamination errors in velocity-gradient analysis.
engineering_relevance: The framework can automate turbulence diagnosis and guide improved modeling decisions, including subgrid-scale model refinement for complex flows.
method: Triple-decomposes the velocity-gradient tensor into rigid rotation, pure shear, and normal strain.
Uses an LLM-based discover-physics agent plus a review agent to infer and validate physical mechanisms.
Builds a growing Triple Decomposition Library for cross-case statistical knowledge transfer.
evidence_signal: The method is validated across five benchmarks and end-to-end on periodic hill flow, where it autonomously proposes turbulence-modeling improvements with better Reynolds-stress predictions.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of automated decomposition and agent reasoning, so physical validation is still needed before using outputs for high-stakes design decisions.
paper_title: PhysMiner: An Agentic AI Framework for Discovering Turbulence Physics
